mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_TB (USER_ID, NICKNAME, NAME, GENDER, PHONE, EMAIL, BIRTHDATE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, ZIPCODE, REFUND_ACCOUNT, REFUND_BANK) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{zipcode}, #{refundAccount}, #{refundBank})
mapper.update: UPDATE CUSTOMER_TB SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, NAME = #{name}, GENDER = #{gender}, PHONE = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, BIRTHDATE = #{birthDate}, ADDRESS = #{address}, ADDRESS_DETAIL = #{addressDetail}, ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, REFUND_ACCOUNT = #{refundAccount}, REFUND_BANK = #{refundBank} WHERE ID = #{id}
